components.name: Control group
components.description: Control group — settings panel pattern (complex component, CMP-09): an optional title and 2–4 control rows (Scrub field, Switch field, Select, Text field). Rows are exposed instances — swap or edit them. Density Default = M rows (44), gap 8; Compact = XS/S rows (32/36), gap 4 — Web/Tablet only. React: <ControlGroup title density>{children}</ControlGroup>. Props: Title, Show title, Show

Design System
3.20 Control group
Settings panel pattern: a short title and 2–4 control rows — Scrub field, Switch field, Select or Text field — stacked with one gap. For editors, tool panels and preference sheets.
Overview
Groups several settings under one heading; each row is a full component, not a nested atom (CMP-09).

Usage
• 2–4 rows per group; split longer lists into several groups with their own titles.
• Order: numeric values first, toggles last, destructive actions never inside a group.
• Changes apply instantly — no Save button. If values need Save, use a form with Fieldset (3.19).
• Several groups side by side make a settings panel (e.g. Characters · Motion · Color · Pointer).
Panel example
Four groups in one Compact panel — Web 1440.
